org_structure: Flat structure with CEO (Alex) leading three functional areas: Product and Engineering (CTO hire), Sales and Partnerships (founder-led initially), and Customer Success (first hire after pilot). Advisory board of 2-3 business school deans for credibility and network access.

capability_gaps.gap: Technical CTO with LMS integration experience
Data science for predictive engagement models
GDPR and education data compliance expertise
Business school network and sales relationships

personnel_policy: Remote-first within EU timezone (UTC-1 to UTC+3). Competitive salaries benchmarked at 75th percentile for EU SaaS startups. Equity pool of 15% reserved for first 10 hires. Annual learning budget of 3000 EUR per employee. Quarterly in-person team gatherings.
knowledge_gaps: No team member currently has direct LMS vendor partnership experience
GDPR Data Protection Officer qualification needed but not yet sourced
No existing relationship with accreditation bodies at institutional level
